query:
SELECT 
  cp.id, cp.firstName, cp.lastName,
  COUNT(a.id) as totalAchievements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.sageEnrichment IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(a.sageEnrichment)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enrichedAchievements
FROM client_profiles cp
LEFT JOIN achievements a ON a.clientId = cp.id
GROUP BY cp.id
HAVING totalAchievements >= 15
ORDER BY cp.id;
